results.title: EU GPU Price Index, October 2026: H100, H200, B200 per hour | Lindstead
results.author: Rogier Muller
highlights:
In October 2026, EU-headquartered cloud providers list an NVIDIA H100 at €2.80 to €3.95 per GPU hour on demand. The US hyperscalers charge €6.03 (AWS), €6.12 (Azure) and €9.70 (Google Cloud). Nebius raised its on-demand GPU prices on 1 October 2026. All figures are published list prices, accessed 1 October 2026, with the source per row. 

## Summary

1. EU-headquartered providers rent an H100 for €2.80 to €3.95 an hour, about half the AWS and Azure price.
2. Prices rose. Nebius added 17 to 21 percent on 1 October; Scaleway and Verda added 1 to 5 percent.
3. US specialist clouds such as RunPod and Lambda charge about what European providers charge. Jurisdiction decides between them.

## What does an H100 cost per hour in October 2026?

 The index lists on-demand prices per GPU hour at fourteen providers: seven headquartered in the EU, seven in the US. The last column shows the move against the September edition.

| Hetzner | DE | Private | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | Unchanged |
| Verda | FI | Private | €3.18 | €4.15 | €6.07 | €7.56 | +1 to 3% |

 On-demand list prices per GPU hour, excluding VAT; accessed 1 October 2026. Scaleway, OVHcloud and IONOS publish in euro; the others publish in dollars, converted at the ECB reference rate of 25 September 2026 (€1 = $1.1403). Multi-GPU instance prices are divided by the number of GPUs. H100 PCIe at RunPod and Lambda, H100 NVL at Azure, H200 PCIe at IONOS, SXM elsewhere. Vast.ai: marketplace median. n/a: no public list price. 

 Hetzner rents no H100-class GPU. Its GEX131 dedicated server with one 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 costs €1,199 a month. STACKIT publishes no GPU prices and quotes on request. 

## What changed since September?

 Nebius raised its on-demand prices on 1 October 2026, as its price page had announced in September. The increase was 17 percent for the H100 and 21 percent for the B300. Verda and Scaleway also rose, by 1 to 5 percent.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nebius | H100 | €3.38 | €3.95 | +17% |
| Nebius | H200 | €3.95 | €4.74 | +20% |
| Nebius | B200 | €6.27 | €7.45 | +19% |
| Nebius | B300 | €6.88 | €8.33 | +21% |
| Verda | H100 | €3.09 | €3.18 | +3% |
| Verda | H200 | €4.03 | €4.15 | +3% |
| Verda | B200 | €5.98 | €6.07 | +1% |
| Verda | B300 | €7.34 | €7.56 | +3% |

 Sources: nebius.com/prices, verda.com/pricing, scaleway.com/en/pricing/gpu; accessed 27 September and 1 October 2026. Both editions use the ECB reference rate of 25 September 2026, so the change reflects list prices only. 

 OVHcloud, Hetzner, AWS, Azure and Google Cloud did not change their prices. STACKIT still publishes none. 

 Three changes are in method. OVHcloud now appears at its own euro price of €2.80; September converted its dollar price, which has not changed, to €2.62. Google Cloud shows €9.70 against €9.71, because the index now divides the instance price itself. IONOS appears with an H200 at €3.00 per GPU hour, from a price list valid since 15 September 2026. RunPod, Lambda, Vast.ai and CoreWeave are new to the index.

...

- ### How much does an NVIDIA H100 cost per hour in Europe? 

On 1 October 2026, EU-headquartered providers list an H100 at €2.80 (OVHcloud) to €3.95 (Nebius) per GPU hour on demand, excluding VAT. AWS lists €6.03, Azure €6.12 and Google Cloud €9.70 in their US regions.
- ### Did Nebius raise its GPU prices in October 2026? 

Yes. On 1 October 2026 Nebius raised its on-demand prices by 17 to 21 percent. An H100 went from €3.38 to €3.95 per hour, an H200 from €3.95 to €4.74, a B200 from €6.27 to €7.45 and a B300 from €6.88 to €8.33.

results.title: On 1 October 2026, Nebius raises its on-demand GPU prices by 17 to 21 percent. | Lindstead
results.author: Lindstead
highlights:
# On 1 October 2026, Nebius raises its on-demand GPU prices by 17 to 21 percent. | Lindstead · LinkedIn · 2026-09-28T00:00:00+00:00

**Lindstead**.

---

On 1 October 2026, Nebius raises its on-demand GPU prices by 17 to 21 percent.

Nebius is headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Nasdaq. Its list prices per GPU-hour change as follows:
• H100: €3.38 to €3.95
• H200: €3.95 to €4.74
• B200: €6.27 to €7.45
• B300: €6.88 to €8.33

It fits a wider pattern:
• The median rental price of an H200 rose by about 25 percent in twelve months.
• Each newer GPU generation costs more per hour.

For organisations planning to run AI on infrastructure they control, the cost side of the business case is moving. Committed-use discounts of up to 35 percent are available at several providers, so contract terms now matter as much as list prices.

Prices at ten European and US providers, with ownership and jurisdiction, updated monthly:

results.title: Huurprijs voor Europese GPU-capaciteit stijgt tot 21 procent - MSP Business
results.author: Redactie
highlights:
Nebius verhoogt per 1 oktober 2026 zijn uurprijzen voor het huren van GPU-capaciteit met 17 tot 21 procent. Dat blijkt uit de maandelijkse Europese GPU-prijsindex van onderzoeksbureau Lindstead. Volgens dezelfde index huur je een NVIDIA H100 bij Europese aanbieders nog steeds voor ongeveer de helft van de prijs bij AWS en Microsoft Azure.

De prijsverhoging bij het in Amsterdam gevestigde Nebius geldt voor meerdere GPU-generaties. Een NVIDIA H100 gaat van ongeveer €3,38 naar €3,95 per uur ($3,85 naar $4,50). Voor de B300, de nieuwste generatie, stijgt het uurtarief van ongeveer €6,88 naar €8,33 ($7,85 naar $9,50).

...

### Europese aanbieders onder hyperscalerprijzen

Uit de index blijkt dat Europese aanbieders een H100 op on-demandbasis verhuren voor ongeveer de helft van de prijs bij AWS en Microsoft Azure, en voor ongeveer een derde van het tarief bij Google Cloud. Het Franse OVHcloud rekent volgens de index ongeveer €2,62 per uur, het Finse Verda €3,09 en Nebius vanaf 1 oktober €3,95. Scaleway uit Frankrijk vermeldt prijzen vanaf €2,73 per uur.

Bij de Amerikaanse hyperscalers liggen de uurtarieven voor een H100 hoger. AWS rekent €6,03, Microsoft Azure €6,12 en Google Cloud €9,71 per uur.

Lindstead baseert de cijfers op de prijspagina’s van de aanbieders en op getdeploying.com, geraadpleegd op 27 september 2026. Dollarprijzen zijn omgerekend tegen de ECB-referentiekoers van 25 september 2026 (1 euro = 1,1403 dollar). De vergelijking betreft openbare on-demandprijzen. Tarieven bij reserveringen, langlopende contracten of maatwerkafspraken kunnen afwijken.

results.title: GPU rental without hyperscalers: How good are neo clouds?
results.author: Benedikt Langer
highlights:
At Lambda, an H100 GPU costs 3.55 euros an hour, against 10.95 euros at Azure, according to the price list of 4 October 2026. Neo clouds such as CoreWeave, Nebius and Lambda offer another option alongside hyperscalers. Several providers expand using secured loans. CoreWeave depends on a few large customers for much of its revenue.

...

- Neo clouds rent out primarily GPU compute time, and on the list prices for an H100 hour they sit well below AWS and Azure, though Nebius raised its H100 hourly rate by 17 percent on 1 October 2026.
- As of 30 June 2026, CoreWeave carried debt equivalent to 31.24 billion euros, and Microsoft accounted for roughly 67 percent of CoreWeave’s revenue in 2025.
- European capacity is being created at Telekom in Munich, at Nebius in Finland and France, and in up to seven planned EU gigafactories.

...

For an hour on an Nvidia H100 GPU, the range on 4 October 2026 is wide. The rates are only comparable to a limited extent. Lambda charges the equivalent of 3.55 euros for the H100 SXM, calculated at the European Central Bank (ECB) reference rate of 2 October 2026. Nebius has been charging the equivalent of 4.01 euros since 1 October 2026, and CoreWeave charges the equivalent of 43.87 euros for a node with eight H100s, which works out at 5.48 euros per GPU. In the US East region, AWS charges the equivalent of 6.13 euros per GPU hour for the p5.48xlarge instance with eight H100s, according to the price tracker Vantage as of 3 October 2026. For the Azure VM ND96isr H100 v5, AzureSpeed lists the equivalent of 10.95 euros per GPU hour as of 26 September 2026 for Linux with usage-based billing in East US.

...

On 1 October 2026, Nebius raised the H100 hour from the equivalent of 3.43 to 4.01 euros, and the B200 from 6.37 to 7.57 euros. On 17 September 2026, CoreWeave reported short-duration contracts of three to six months at roughly 36 million euros in revenue per megawatt per year.

results.title: Europe's cheapest H100 is now €1.89 (Seeweb, verified)
results.author: Gunars Mie
highlights:
No big price moves this week, but a new #1 H100, a €0.38 L4 and IONOS finally shows its H200 price.

...

Oct 19, 2026

Prices checked 19 Oct 2026. On-demand, per GPU-hour, ex-VAT.

New #1 H100: Seeweb at €1.89. Last week we kept Seeweb out of the ranking because we couldn't confirm the price was per GPU. Now we have: Seeweb's own price table charges €1.89/h per H100, times the number of GPUs. That is 31% below the next one, Gcore bare metal at €2.73.

Source: https://www.seeweb.it/en/products/cloud-server-gpu

H100 ranking, cheapest first:

- Seeweb €1.89
- Gcore €2.73
- OVHcloud €2.80
- Scaleway €2.87 (approx.)
- Verda €3.82
- Nebius €4.00 ($4.50)

Newly listed:

- Seeweb L4: €0.38/h, about half of OVHcloud's €0.75.
- IONOS H200 (Germany): €3.00/h. The page doesn't say whether VAT is included.
- Gcore B300 bare metal: €6.00/h per GPU (you order it through sales).

Small moves: Verda raised its USD prices by about 2% (H100 $4.21 to $4.296). It now publishes EUR prices, so we use those directly: H100 €3.82 (was €3.76). Nebius's dollar prices didn't change. Its euro prices only shift with the ECB rate (1.1253 on 16 Oct).
